svg.text: R2
9 steps
Find markers associated with salt tolerance in the uploaded cohort.
R1
R2
Replanned: λ = 2.8024 in revision 1 — the statistics are inflated genome-wide, which is population structure rather than signal.
WHAT THE USER ASKED
Which markers are associated with salt
tolerance in this cohort?
120 samples · 150 markers
WHAT THE AGENT CHANGED
R2
The first scan was not wrong about the
arithmetic. It was wrong about the model:
ancestry moves the phenotype and most
allele frequencies at once.
▸ revision 2 published · 9 steps · validated before anything ran
▸ quality control running · the only step with no unmet dependency
▸ qc succeeded → ancestry and relatedness dispatched together
▸ no edge between those two, so the engine did not serialise them
▸ the scan waited for both parents — fan-in, not a race
▸ correcting for multiple testing
▸ λ = 0.9461 · the null is calibrated and the three hits stand
